provenance_note: Sources studied are recorded privately by the author; no third-party text, prompts or code are reproduced.
validation: Not benchmarked for this release. The projected impact below is an estimate for the Agent Orchestrator persona, not a measurement. Structural gate (scripts/verify.py) passed at packaging time; the bundled helper scripts have their own tests. A behavioural benchmark is planned.

projected_impact.routine_plans: No change expected on simple planning: capable models already produce valid plans.
projected_impact.policy_bound_work: Better adherence expected where explicit limits apply: agent budgets, context caps, retry and escalation limits, verification before dependants, and stopping overrunning workers. Projected range: 0 to +20 percentage points on plan and decision checks. The upper bound is the published average gain for compact procedural skills when an agent lacks the procedure; stronger models are expected nearer the low end.
projected_impact.merging: More disagreements surfaced and fewer silently dropped facets expected when merging several workers' results.
projected_impact.cost: Little extra time expected: projected up to about 1.2 times a plain agent on planning tasks.
projected_impact.basis: Published research on procedural agent skills and the author's development testing.

scope_notes: Projected at persona level, not for this skill alone.
Estimates, not measurements: no uplift is demonstrated and none is refuted.
No universal model or harness performance claim.
